$Comment: Give Christmas Presents to other players during one Christmas. A present pointed at another player and used counts as USE_ITEM with the Qualifier Gift (Item/Interactions/Christmas/Christmas_Present_Give.json), and only a gift that landed counts; a present given to Santa or a helper carries that character's id instead, so it never counts here. The description's number comes from the criterion's Amount through @amount. It carries no merry tag, so the Merrymaker never waits on other players. Each year's copy pays a few Christmas Coins and MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row once, Crafting XP for the presents, both waiting on the achievements page until the player collects them. The Mmo_Xp row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a server without that mod, unpaid and unshown, and the coins still pay. The _Christmas folder makes the id christmas_secret_santa.
